title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1978-04-08

ai_review.summary: Nice soundboard mix comparable to CM's, but the performance itself feels unremarkable
ai_review.review: The recording offers a clean, well‑balanced mix that holds up nicely against other Miller sources. However, the reviewer wasn’t excited by the show, describing it as not very wild and giving it an average rating.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate‑star review; positive comments on recording quality but lukewarm about the performance lead to a blended rating around three stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Nice mix, clear and balanced, comparable to other Miller soundboard recordings (CM's).

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer found the show unexciting and not particularly wild.
